nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What does the European Strategy on green infrastructure aim to achieve?
nodes.answer: The European Strategy on green infrastructure aims to enhance biodiversity conservation through the promotion of ecological networks that benefit both people and nature.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife corridor conservation|Green corridor initiatives_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the main concern discussed regarding the relationship between green infrastructure (GI) and biodiversity conservation?
nodes.answer: The relationship between GI and effective biodiversity conservation may be relatively weak, as increasing structural connectivity may not directly support biodiversity.
